configure_hornet_base_backbone: configure a HorNet base architecture backbone with drop_path_rate 0.5 for image classification
configure_linear_classification_head: configure a LinearClsHead with 1000 classes and 1024 input channels for image classification
configure_label_smoothing_loss: configure LabelSmoothLoss with smoothing value 0.1 in original mode for the classification head
configure_model_initialization: configure TruncNormal and Constant initialization for Linear, LayerNorm, and LayerScale layers
configure_training_augmentations: configure Mixup and CutMix data augmentation strategies for training the HorNet model
